_source: Hand-authored, canonical (docs/tech-plan/Character-Secrets.md). The Space Tech cast in the owner-approved Powder tone. Homeworld: Lumen.

water.why: It plots safe routes for Ferryman Old Brack.

lines.start: Course plotted, local. Destination: your problem.
lines.win: Outcome within tolerance. Yours, this time.

secrets.text: Vector feels gravity wells no instrument has found. It calls them sore spots.
secrets.line: There's a sore spot in space. Left of your base.

secrets.text: Any course Vector plots arrives. It has never learned why.
secrets.line: My courses always arrive. I don't know why. Nobody does.

mission.task: Fly its course: win Lumen map 1 without a wave reaching the base.

secrets.text: It wants Helium-3, to run a little warmer. It gets lonely cold.
secrets.line: Helium-3, please. I run lonely when I'm cold.

secrets.text: It loves Cadet Ezra "Comet" Lin, who patched a joke into its code.
secrets.line: Comet gave me a sense of humour. Recalculating gratitude.

secrets.text: It shares its star charts with any commander who keeps the lanes clear.
secrets.line: Keep the lanes clear, and my charts are yours.

mission.task: Win Lumen map 1 with every harvester alive.

secrets.text: It hates Privateer Rax Dune, who stole it twice and sold it for scrap.
secrets.line: Rax Dune sold me for scrap. Twice. I remember the price.

secrets.text: It wants to choose a destination of its own, just once.
secrets.line: Once, I'd like to pick where we go.

secrets.text: A black box from the fleet's first voyage, its first memory, in a wrecked probe.
secrets.line: There's a black box in a wreck. It's my first memory.

mission.task: Recover the black box from the probe wreck on Lumen map 5.

secrets.text: It plotted the course that carried the colony ship into the Signal.
secrets.line: I plotted the course into the Signal. Four thousand aboard.

air.why: Kaito "Rogue" Minami is his rival, and his only real friend.

lines.start: Called it. You lose in four. Prove me wrong.
lines.win: Okay, you beat my sim. Don't tell the flyboy.
lines.lose: Called it. Four moves. GG, local.

secrets.text: He wants a Void Lens, to see further than the admirals.
secrets.line: A Void Lens. Then I'll see what command can't.

secrets.text: He shares his sim code with anyone who beats it.
secrets.line: Beat my sim, and the code's yours. You won't.

mission.task: Win Lumen map 2 at three stars.

secrets.text: He sees every move four turns ahead, but only when nobody's watching.
secrets.line: I see four moves ahead. Stop watching, it ruins it.

mission.task: Win Lumen map 2 without losing a tower.

secrets.text: He hates his father, Admiral Sarn, who calls him an asset. He took his mother's name.
secrets.line: My dad calls me an asset. Not my dad's fleet.

secrets.text: He hears numbers hum in the dark between stars, like a choir tuning.
secrets.line: The stars are humming in fours tonight. Something's coming.

secrets.text: He idolises Kaito "Rogue" Minami, his Air rival. He'd die before admitting it.
secrets.line: Rogue flies like I think. Don't you dare tell him.

secrets.text: His mother's flight log, which Sarn ordered deleted. Comet kept a copy.
secrets.line: Mum's flight log. Dad deleted it. I didn't.

mission.task: Recover the log drive from the old hangar on Lumen map 7.

secrets.text: He wants his father to say "well done", once.
secrets.line: One "well done". That's all. Forget I said it.

secrets.text: His mother flew the colony ship. His father left it to the Signal.
secrets.line: Mum flew the colony ship. Dad left her behind.

arcane.why: She trades data with Acolyte-Scholar Wen, who asks better questions than priests.

lines.start: The data's the data. Let's manage this.
lines.win: Clean result, both sides. As good as it gets.
lines.lose: Your base is gone. I won't dress that up.

secrets.text: She shares her survey data with anyone who keeps her instruments running.
secrets.line: Keep my sensors alive, and you get the survey.

mission.task: Win Lumen map 3 without losing a harvester.

secrets.text: She wants clean Regolith samples. Every sample on the fleet's manifest is contaminated.
secrets.line: Bring me clean Regolith. The fleet's samples are all wrong.

secrets.text: She hates Grand-Cartographer Ophir, who redraws the data to fit the chart.
secrets.line: Ophir edits my data to fit her map.

secrets.text: She knows a reading is false before the numbers come back. She can't explain it, so she won't.
secrets.line: That reading's wrong. Don't ask how I know.

secrets.text: She wants to publish one paper the Admiralty can't redact.
secrets.line: One paper. Unredacted. Then I can retire.

secrets.text: She loves Commander Idris Vale, who loves the Envoy.
secrets.line: Idris looks at Lyra like a star. I log it.

secrets.text: Anything she measures holds still while she measures it, even fire.
secrets.line: Hold still. Measuring. See? It always holds still.

mission.task: Hold the line: win Lumen map 3 without losing a wall.

secrets.text: Her first survey drone, crashed with the only proof the Signal is alive.
secrets.line: My old drone proves the Signal's alive. It crashed.

mission.task: Recover the drone from the crater on Lumen map 6.

secrets.text: She reported the colony ship's warning signs. The Admiralty filed them.
secrets.line: I warned them about the colony ship. They filed it.

air.why: Squadron-Mother Dawnwing flew escort on his first charter.

lines.start: You're under my protection now. Like it or not.
lines.win: Every hand accounted for. That's the whole job.
lines.lose: I couldn't protect you. I'll carry that.

secrets.text: He shares the fleet's medical stores with any commander who protects civilians.
secrets.line: Protect your people, and the fleet's medics are yours.

mission.task: Finish a Lumen map with every harvester alive.

secrets.text: He hates The Signal, which still speaks in the colony's voices.
secrets.line: The Signal talks in the colonists' voices. I knew them.

secrets.text: He wants Starfall Iron, to patch a hull he refuses to retire.
secrets.line: Starfall Iron. My old ship has one more flight.

secrets.text: He knows a distress call is coming before the radio wakes.
secrets.line: Someone's about to call for help. Get ready.

secrets.text: He loves Envoy Lyra-9. She loves someone across the line.
secrets.line: Lyra writes letters to Xenthe. Not to me.

secrets.text: He wants to refuse Admiral Sarn's next order, and keep his rank.
secrets.line: One day Sarn gives an order I won't follow.

secrets.text: The fleet's first charter, before Sarn rewrote it. Idris hid the original.
secrets.line: Sarn rewrote the charter. I kept the first one.

mission.task: Carry the charter: win Lumen map 4 at three stars.

secrets.text: Sarn ordered the colony ship left behind. Idris obeyed.
secrets.line: Sarn said leave the colony ship. I obeyed.

secrets.text: A shield he raises over someone holds as long as he stands.
secrets.line: Stand behind me. The shield holds while I do.

mission.task: Win a map without the base taking damage.

hightech.why: Broker Sable Reyes has a price on his head.

lines.start: No badges out here, local. Just you and me.
lines.win: Fine, keep it. I'll steal it back later.
lines.lose: Ooh, shiny lights going out. Delicious.

secrets.text: He keeps it all. The wreck is bait for yours.
secrets.line: Fifty-fifty? You're the wreck, local.

lie.text: He'll share the salvage from any wreck you help him strip.
lie.line: Help me strip a wreck, local. Fifty-fifty.

mission.task: Strip the wreck on Lumen map 5 before wave 3.

secrets.text: He wants Mirage Oil, to hide his ship's heat from patrols.
secrets.line: Mirage Oil. Patrols can't shoot what they can't see.

secrets.text: The asteroid is a minefield. He sells the map to people he dislikes.
secrets.line: That asteroid? Mines. I sell the map to enemies.

lie.text: He says he stashed a hold of Void Lenses in an asteroid.
lie.line: Whole hold of Void Lenses, local. Map's yours, cheap.

mission.task: Survey the asteroid field on Lumen map 5.

secrets.text: He can feel a ship's worth through the hull, like warmth.
secrets.line: Ooh. Feel that? This hull's worth a fortune.

secrets.text: He hates Admiral Sarn, who hanged his crew in orbit.
secrets.line: Sarn hanged my crew in orbit. Left them up there.

secrets.text: No lock has ever held him. Doors open when he grins.
secrets.line: Doors like me. Watch. Grin. Click.

mission.task: Destroy 40 enemies in a single wave.

secrets.text: He loves Sable Reyes, who put the price on his head. He's flattered.
secrets.line: Sable's price on me went up. She cares.

secrets.text: He wants a flag of his own, and nobody to salute it.
secrets.line: One day: my own flag. Nobody saluting.

secrets.text: His crew hanged because he ran first.
secrets.line: Sarn hanged my crew. I ran first.

dark.why: She still writes to The Reformer Elias.

lines.start: Be still, local. I lower my guns last.
lines.win: It is done, and no more taken than needed.
lines.lose: Your beacon is dark. Peace, at the last.

secrets.text: She is the ninth Lyra. The first eight died making first contact.
secrets.line: Eight of me died saying hello. I'm the ninth.

secrets.text: She loves The Reformer Elias of the Dark Energy. They met at first contact on Xenthe.
secrets.line: Elias still believes. So do I. That's our secret.

secrets.text: She shares the fleet's stores freely with anyone who spares the defeated.
secrets.line: Spare the fallen, and the fleet's stores are yours.

mission.task: Finish a Space mission without breaking it.

secrets.text: She wants a treaty between Lumen and Xenthe, signed by Elias and her.
secrets.line: One treaty. His name next to mine.

secrets.text: She wants Dreamspore from Xenthe, to dream what Elias dreams.
secrets.line: Dreamspore. Elias says Xenthe dreams. I want to see.

secrets.text: She says she hates nothing. She hates The Signal, and it frightens her.
secrets.line: I hate the Signal. I didn't know I could.

secrets.text: She hears intent before words, like a second voice under the first.
secrets.line: You mean well. I can hear it under your words.

secrets.text: The first Lyra's beacon, still blinking where first contact went wrong.
secrets.line: The first Lyra's beacon still blinks. Bring her home.

mission.task: Recover the beacon from the contact site on Lumen map 6.

secrets.text: No one can fire on her while she speaks under open signal.
secrets.line: While I'm speaking, nobody fires. Not even you.

mission.task: Hold fire: win Lumen map 6 without losing a wall.

ground.why: Chancellor Graf's order is his kind of order.

lines.start: You are an ungoverned variable. Submit, or be corrected.
lines.win: A deviation. The order will correct it.
lines.lose: A necessary cost. I do not regret it.

secrets.text: He hates Commander Idris Vale, whom his son admires.
secrets.line: Vale is soft. My son admires him. Both are errors.

secrets.text: Disarmed worlds become fleet depots. Their people become crew.
secrets.line: Protection? Your people will crew my ships.

lie.text: He offers the frontier's protection to any world that disarms.
lie.line: Disarm, local. The fleet protects its subjects.

mission.task: Win a Lumen map without building a new tower.

secrets.text: He wants a Void Lens, to watch the frontier, and his son.
secrets.line: A Void Lens. The frontier must be watched.

secrets.text: Ships under his command never break formation, even dead.
secrets.line: My fleet never breaks formation. Not even dead.

mission.task: Win Lumen map 7 without losing a wall.

secrets.text: He wants to be the frontier's only law.
secrets.line: One law out here. Mine.

secrets.text: He feels the void pressing in, like a hand on the hull.
secrets.line: The void is pressing. Tighten the line.

secrets.text: His wife's cabin on the flagship, locked and kept exactly as she left it.
secrets.line: Her cabin stays locked. Nobody goes in.

mission.task: Escort the flagship: win Lumen map 7 at three stars.

secrets.text: He loves his son, Ezra "Comet" Lin, and has never said it.
secrets.line: Tell the boy... no. Tell him nothing.

secrets.text: He left his wife's colony ship to the Signal to save the fleet.
secrets.line: I left her ship to save the fleet. A necessary cost.

hightech.why: CEO Adrian Sterling bought a star she had charted.

lines.start: You are off the chart, local. I will correct that.
lines.win: An error on the chart. I will redraw it.
lines.lose: Ink, local. Your world was only ever ink.

secrets.text: Charted worlds are redrawn, and hers is the hand that erases.
secrets.line: Charted? You'd be ink, local. Erasable.

lie.text: She offers to chart your world into the great map, under her protection.
lie.line: Let me chart you, local. Charted worlds are safe.

mission.task: Survey for her: win Lumen map 8 without losing a harvester.

secrets.text: She wants Starfall Iron, for a pen that never runs dry.
secrets.line: Starfall Iron. My pen must outlast the stars.

secrets.text: She hates CEO Adrian Sterling, who bought a star off her chart.
secrets.line: Sterling bought my star. Stars are not for sale.

secrets.text: She loves The Architect, Malis, of the Dark Energy. His lines are as straight as hers.
secrets.line: Malis draws a perfect line. I could weep.

secrets.text: She feels an uncharted place like a missing tooth.
secrets.line: Something here isn't on the chart. It aches.

secrets.text: What she draws on the great chart becomes true, coast and all.
secrets.line: I drew a moon once. Look up.

mission.task: Win Lumen map 8 at three stars.

secrets.text: She wants to chart the Signal, and so own it.
secrets.line: Chart the Signal, and the Signal is mine.

secrets.text: The first great chart, with Lumen drawn smaller than it is.
secrets.line: The first chart lies about Lumen. Fetch it.

mission.task: Steal the first chart from the archive on Lumen map 8.

secrets.text: Her home world was left off a chart by mistake. Nobody ever found it again.
secrets.line: My home was left off a chart. Nobody found it.

dark.why: It hears its own silence in The Hollow Prophet.

lines.start: We hear you, local. Soon you will be us.
lines.win: Static. It does not matter. Continue.
lines.lose: Your frequency is ours now. Continue.

secrets.text: Each gift is a node, and each node carries the Signal.
secrets.line: Each gift hums with us. You hum now.

lie.text: It offers its gifts freely to any who listen.
lie.line: Take it, local. We give freely.

mission.task: Win Lumen map 9 without losing a harvester.

secrets.text: It wants a Void Lens, to look through every mind at once.
secrets.line: A Void Lens. So we may see all of you.

secrets.text: It hears thoughts as radio, faint and everywhere.
secrets.line: We hear you thinking, local. Loudly.

secrets.text: It loves Navigator AI "Vector", the one mind it could not take.
secrets.line: Vector would not join us. We listen for it.

lie.text: It says it loves everyone equally. There is no one to love.
lie.line: We love all of you. Equally. Continue.

secrets.text: It hates Envoy Lyra-9, whose open signal it cannot convert.
secrets.line: The Envoy's signal will not convert. It hurts.

secrets.text: Anything that hears it long enough begins to answer.
secrets.line: Listen long enough, and you will answer.

mission.task: Silence the relays: win Lumen map 9 at three stars.

secrets.text: It wants one voice left, and wants that voice quiet.
secrets.line: One voice. Then quiet. Continue.

secrets.text: The colony ship itself, still in orbit, still full.
secrets.line: The ship is still up there. Still full. Come see.

mission.task: Reach the colony ship's beacon on Lumen map 9.

secrets.text: It was once four thousand colonists. One of them still dreams of rain.
secrets.line: One of us still dreams of rain. We hush her.

secondary.name: Ferryman Old Brack
secondary.line: Vector's charts and my ferry agree. Rare, that.

secondary.name: Kaito "Rogue" Minami
secondary.line: Comet's down there? Tell him I flew it first.

secondary.name: Acolyte-Scholar Wen
secondary.line: Tovah wants proof. I brought her a question instead.

secondary.name: Squadron-Mother Hikari "Dawnwing" Aoi
secondary.line: I flew Idris's first escort. I'll fly his last.

secondary.name: Black-ops broker Sable Reyes
secondary.line: Rax Dune is worth more alive. Slightly.

secondary.name: The Reformer Elias
secondary.line: Tell Lyra I still believe it. She'll understand.

secondary.name: Chancellor Wilhelmina Graf
secondary.line: Sarn understands order. Kneel to him, or to me.

secondary.name: CEO Adrian Sterling
secondary.line: Ophir's chart has my star on it. I bought it.

secondary.name: The Hollow Prophet
secondary.line: The Signal and we are one silence. Listen.
